name: Neuro Bass Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Bass sounds for Neuro Bass for drum & bass and bass music: neurofunk with moving vowel formants, detune stacks, liquid sub-mids, jump-up wobbles, dancefloor mains, clean subs, dubstep and bass music, techno, and stabs and hits. No pattern is stored; play them from a keyboard or a sequencer. Levels are matched to each other and to the other bass synths.
